evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt, depends configurations, CI setups, and bumps the minimum compiler requirements to GCC 13 and Clang 19.
rationale: Bumping the minimum standard to C++23 removes compiler-level friction and unblocks dependencies like libmultiprocess that already require C++23 features. Author notes that "workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating" and the bump is required to unlock downstream work discussed in #34979.
